sources.title: Functional Multi-Target Detection via Bispectrum Inversion
sources.reading_notes: The repeated-signal recovery model uses stationary Gaussian noise and debiased third-order autocorrelation. Our proposed single-window normalized diagonal product is neither their estimator nor their inversion algorithm. Heteroscedastic Poisson/read noise and tapering prevent importing their recovery or unbiasedness guarantees.

sources.title: Unifying Amplitude-Phase Coupling and Reliable Endogenous Priors for Low-Light Image Enhancement
sources.reading_notes: Their RGB enhancement pipeline couples amplitude and trigonometric phase embeddings,then refines an intermediate-derived prior. Its reported fine-texture limitation matters here. We do not adopt APACF,ERP,code or weights;our proposed diagonal cross-frequency statistic and RAW trial are independently implemented.

own_proposal: Expose real/imag coordinates of u(w)^2*conj(u(2w mod S)) for observed RAW and innovation. u=F/sqrt(sum_phase|F|^2+sum_phase noise),with existing1e-12 floor.16 features/one zero512-parameter projection. Test actual V162 control at unchanged paired+target-flat losses. Additional capacity/compute is part of comparison;single-window products are not calibrated confidence or guaranteed unbiased signal.
